data.notes: August’s confirmed calendar is led by Ubud’s jazz festival and AXEAN’s regional showcase, while most Bali beach-club and nightclub calendars remain only partially announced this far out.

events.title: Hayden James at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Savaya Bali lists Hayden James as the headline act for Saturday, August 1, with doors at 3:00 PM and DJs through the day leading up to the main act.

events.title: Ubud Village Jazz Festival 2026
events.venueName: Sthala, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, Ubud Bali
events.summary: The 13th Ubud Village Jazz Festival is confirmed for August 7–8, 2026 at Sthala Ubud Bali, presenting two evenings of jazz with Indonesian and international artists.

events.title: Joel Corry at Desa Kitsuné
events.summary: Megatix lists UK DJ and producer Joel Corry at Desa Kitsuné on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, with the event starting at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Buleleng Festival 2026 – Samsara: The Cycle of Titik Mula
events.summary: The Buleleng Regency tourism calendar confirms Buleleng Festival 2026 for August 23–28, describing it as North Bali’s biggest annual event with the theme “Samsara: The Cycle of Titik Mula.”

events.title: AXEAN Festival 2026
events.summary: AXEAN Festival is confirmed for August 29–30, 2026 at Jimbaran Hub, bringing two days of live music, culture, and creative exchange focused on Southeast Asian artists and industry connections.
